steps.action: Disable the newly created admin account immediately — do not delete until forensics is complete.
Identify who or what created the account: check the event log for the creating process, PID, and parent session.
Determine if the creating account was itself compromised or if this was an authorised provisioning workflow gone wrong.
Audit any actions the rogue admin account performed before detection.
Remove the account and any backdoors (SSH keys, scheduled tasks, startup scripts) it may have planted.
Enforce privileged identity management (PIM) — all admin account creation must go through an approval workflow with MFA.
Document creating entity, account details, and all actions taken during the account's lifetime.
